setup.title: {title} · HomersLab setup
setup.foot: You can stop at any time: what you’ve chosen is kept, and you continue where you stopped. To come back later, make a new link on this machine with sudo homerslab setup link.
setup.refused.title: This link doesn’t work any more
setup.refused.lead: A setup link works once, for 30 minutes, on this machine or your home network. To make a new one, run this on the machine:
setup.error.title: Setup can’t reach HomersLab
setup.error.lead: The manager on this machine didn’t answer. Check that it runs, then reload this page.
setup.error.unbuilt: This step comes with a later version of HomersLab. What you’ve chosen so far is kept.
step.welcome.title: Let’s set up HomersLab
step.welcome.lead: This machine, {host}, will run your household’s apps. It takes about 20 minutes, and you can stop at any time.
step.welcome.backLead: You stopped at {step}. What you chose then is kept.
step.welcome.need.mesh: Your mesh’s token: NetBird, Tailscale or Headscale
step.welcome.need.domain: Your domain and its DNS provider’s token
step.welcome.need.mail: The password of a mailbox HomersLab can send from
step.welcome.need.kit: A printer or a password manager, for the recovery kit
step.welcome.need.device: This laptop or your phone, to put on the mesh
step.welcome.agentSilent: The agent on this machine isn’t answering, so its facts can’t be shown yet.
fact.noTPM: None: secrets are sealed to this machine’s own key
step.you.title: What’s your name?
step.you.lead: You’ll be the household’s admin: you install apps and invite people.
step.you.name: Your name
step.you.mailHint: For alerts, and to reset your passkey.
step.you.why: Your name and a mail address, to continue.
step.you.mailInvalid: Type a mail address, like name@example.org.
step.household.title: Name your household
step.household.lead: Everyone you invite joins it. You can change its name later.
step.household.name: The household’s name
step.household.why: Give the household a name to continue.
step.signin.title: How everyone signs in
step.signin.lead: One household account and a passkey for every app, on the TV too.
step.network.title: Your private network
step.network.lead: It joins your machines and everyone’s devices, at home or away.
step.domain.title: Your domain
step.domain.lead: Every app gets a name under it, with its own certificate. The names answer only on the mesh.
step.mail.title: Sending mail
step.mail.lead: HomersLab writes invites, passkey resets and alerts.
step.kit.title: Your recovery kit
step.kit.lead: Enough to restore everything on new hardware, even without HomersLab.
step.join.title: Put this device on the mesh
step.join.lead: Admin and your passkey live at names that answer only on the mesh. Once this device is on it, you continue there.
step.join.milestoneSub: The first half of setup is done.
step.join.why: Put this device or your phone on the mesh first.
step.passkey.title: Create your passkey
step.done.title: You’re all set
admin.title: {title} · Admin · HomersLab
admin.where: On this machine only, until Admin signs you in over the mesh
admin.error.title: Admin can’t reach HomersLab
admin.error.lead: The manager on this machine didn’t answer. Check that it runs, then reload this page.
admin.notFound.title: Nothing here
admin.notFound.lead: There’s no such page in Admin.
store.title: Store
store.signIn.oidc: Native: with the household account, straight into the app
store.signIn.ldap: Native: with the household account, through LDAP
store.signIn.guard: Guarded: the edge asks for the household account first
store.backups.some: Every hour: {what}. A restore test every week
store.backups.none: Nothing to back up: it keeps no data
store.exposure.public: Mesh only at first; it can be made public later
store.needs.gpu.optional: ; a GPU if there is one, for {what}
store.notSetUp: Finish first-time setup first: a plan needs the household’s name and your mail address.
plan.title: Install {app}
plan.sub: What installing {app} will do, in plain words. Nothing happens until you press Install.
plan.signIn.oidc: With their household account, straight into {app}.
plan.signIn.ldap: With their household account, through LDAP.
plan.signIn.guard: The edge asks for the household account first.
plan.signIn.guard.sub: The edge on {node} asks for the household account, through {provider}, before {app} sees a request.
plan.name: Its name
plan.name.public: On {meshes}, pointing at {node}. Mesh only: you can make it public later, from its page, with your passkey.
plan.name.mesh: On {meshes}, pointing at {node}. Mesh only, always.
plan.backups.none: Nothing to back up: it keeps no data.
plan.backups.foot: Every hour, on the hour. Its restore is tested every week.
plan.amount.grows: Needs {needs} at first, then grows with {what}; {free} free
plan.amount.unknown: Needs {needs}; {node} can’t say how much is free
plan.warn.memory: {node} lacks memory for {app}: it needs {needs}, and {free} is free.
plan.warn.disk: {node} lacks disk for {app}: it needs {needs}, and {free} is free.
plan.warn.diskUnknown: {node} can’t say how much disk is free; {app} needs {needs}.
plan.warn.gpu: {app} needs a GPU from {vendors}, and {node} has none.
plan.warn.lead: It may not install, or not run well.
plan.extras.none: None. This plan needs no passkey.
plan.secrets.tpm.one: 1 secret, made on {node} and sealed to its TPM: {what}. Nobody sees it, you included.
plan.secrets.tpm.many: {n} secrets, made on {node} and sealed to its TPM: {what}. Nobody sees them, you included.
plan.secrets.host.one: 1 secret, made on {node} and sealed with a key only root can read: {what}. Nobody sees it, you included.
plan.secrets.host.many: {n} secrets, made on {node} and sealed with a key only root can read: {what}. Nobody sees them, you included.
plan.creates.guard: A guard at the edge on {node}
plan.creates.name: The name {host}
plan.creates.backups: Hourly backups and a weekly restore test
plan.install.later: Installing comes with a later version of HomersLab.
plan.bound: Plan {id}. Change anything and it becomes a new plan.
plan.boundKey: One passkey approves plan {id} and nothing else. Change anything and it becomes a new plan.
plan.missing.title: No such plan
plan.missing.lead: HomersLab has no plan with this id.
